cards.ex: He felt trapped in a dead-end job with no prospects.
cards.exUz: U hech qanday istiqbolsiz, befoyda ishda qolib ketgandek his qildi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday o'sish yoki rivojlanish imkoniyati bo'lmagan ish.

cards.ex: The contract was mostly boilerplate language, so it didn't take long to review.
cards.exUz: Shartnoma asosan andoza matndan iborat edi, shuning uchun uni ko'rib chiqish ko'p vaqtni olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p ishlatiladigan, o'zgarmas qismlar (masalan, shartnomalarda).

cards.ex: It's crunch time for the marketing team; they're launching the new campaign next week.
cards.exUz: Marketing guruhi uchun qizg'in payt; ular keyingi hafta yangi kampaniyani ishga tushirishadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p ish qilinadigan, qattiq ishlash talab etiladigan davr.

cards.ex: We had to cut through a lot of red tape to get the project approved.
cards.exUz: Loyiha tasdiqlanishi uchun ko'p byurokratiyani yengishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz qoidalar va rasmiyatchiliklar, ayniqsa hukumatda.

cards.ex: Their value proposition is that they offer the highest quality at the lowest price.
cards.exUz: Ularning qiymat taklifi shundaki, ular eng yuqori sifatni eng arzon narxda taklif qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Mahsulot yoki xizmatning foydalari va qadriyati.

cards.ex: Every time we meet a target, they move the goalposts and set a new one.
cards.exUz: Biz har safar maqsadga erishganimizda, ular qoidalarni o'zgartirib, yangisini o'rnatadilar.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarni yoki talablarni o'zgartirmoq, ko'pincha adolatsiz ravishda.

cards.ex: The onboarding process was very thorough and helped me get up to speed quickly.
cards.exUz: Moslashuv jarayoni juda puxta edi va menga tezda ishga tushishimga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi xodimning kompaniyaga moslashuvi uchun qilinadigan harakatlar.

cards.ex: Her skill set is perfect for this role; she's experienced in marketing and sales.
cards.exUz: Uning ko'nikmalar to'plami bu rol uchun juda mos; u marketing va sotuvda tajribaga ega.
cards.uzDef: Insonning ishda foydalanishi mumkin bo'lgan mahorat va qobiliyatlar to'plami.

cards.ex: She's been at the helm of the company for ten years.
cards.exUz: U o'n yildirki kompaniya rahbarligida.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshqarish yoki rahbarlik qilish.

cards.ex: It's hard to get a foot in the door in the film industry.
cards.exUz: Kino sanoatida ishga kirish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Biror sohada ish topishga erishmoq (ko'pincha boshlang'ich pozitsiyada).

cards.ex: The elephant in the room is that we're losing money.
cards.exUz: Asosiy muammo shundaki, biz pul yo'qotyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Hamma biladigan, ammo muhokama qilmaydigan katta muammo.

cards.ex: The project failed, so it's back to the drawing board.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun boshidan boshlash kerak.
cards.uzDef: Reja ishlamasa, yangi reja tuzish uchun qaytish.

cards.ex: She's on the fast track to becoming a senior manager.
cards.exUz: U katta menejer bo'lish yo'lida tezlashtirilgan yo'lda.
cards.uzDef: Tezroq rivojlanish yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishish yo'li.

cards.ex: The hospital is severely understaffed, which puts a strain on the nurses.
cards.exUz: Kasalxonada xodimlar yetishmaydi, bu hamshiralarga zo'riqish yuklaydi.
cards.uzDef: Yetarli xodimlar soniga ega bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: I was out of the loop because I missed the meeting.
cards.exUz: Men yig'ilishni o'tkazib yuborganim uchun voqeadan bexabar edim.
cards.uzDef: Muhim ma'lumotlardan xabardor bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: She raised the bar for everyone with her excellent presentation.
cards.exUz: U o'zining ajoyib taqdimoti bilan hamma uchun standartni oshirdi.
cards.uzDef: Standartni yoki talabni yuqoriroq qilish.

cards.ex: They gave him the ax after years of service.
cards.exUz: Ular uni ko'p yillik xizmatdan so'ng ishdan bo'shatishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ishdan bo'shatmoq.

cards.ex: The company is struggling to stay afloat during the recession.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya tanazzul davrida suvda qolish uchun kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, biznesni davom ettirish.

cards.ex: Let's touch base next week to discuss the project progress.
cards.exUz: Loyiha taraqqiyotini muhokama qilish uchun keyingi hafta aloqada bo'laylik.
cards.uzDef: Qisqacha uchrashish yoki aloqada bo'lish.

cards.ex: His job is on the line if he doesn't meet the sales targets.
cards.exUz: Agar u sotuvlar maqsadlariga erishmasa, uning ishi xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Xavf ostida yoki risk ostida bo'lish.

cards.ex: We had to jump through hoops to get the permit.
cards.exUz: Biz ruxsat olish uchun ko'p qiyinchiliklarni yengishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p qiyinchiliklarni yengish yoki murakkab jarayonlardan o'tish.

cards.ex: The company is behind the curve when it comes to technology.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya texnologiya borasida ortda qolmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Zamonaviy tendensiyalardan ortda qolmoq yoki yangiliklardan bexabar bo'lish.

cards.ex: In a small company, you have to wear many hats.
cards.exUz: Kichik kompaniyada siz ko'p turli xil vazifalarni bajarishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p turli xil vazifalarni bajarish.

cards.ex: She broke through the glass ceiling and became CEO.
cards.exUz: U shisha shiftni buzib o'tib, bosh direktor bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Ayollarning yuqori lavozimlarga ko'tarilishiga to'sqinlik qiladigan to'siq.

cards.ex: The bottom line is that we need to increase profits.
cards.exUz: Asosiy natija shundaki, biz foydani oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oxirgi natija, ayniqsa moliyaviy natija.

cards.ex: The company has a high churn rate, which is a cause for concern.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyaning aylanma koeffitsienti yuqori, bu tashvishga sabab bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Xodimlarning kompaniyani tark etish tezligi.

cards.ex: You need to be able to think on your feet in this job.
cards.exUz: Siz bu ishda tez fikrlay olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tez va samarali fikrlash va javob berish.

cards.ex: We need to get our ducks in a row before we launch the product.
cards.exUz: Mahsulotni ishga tushirishdan oldin hamma narsani tartibga keltirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsa tartibga keltirilgan va tayyor.

cards.ex: They're playing hardball in the negotiations.
cards.exUz: Ular muzokaralarda qattiq kurashmoqdalar.
cards.uzDef: Aggressiv va murosasiz bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: She took the reins of the project after the manager resigned.
cards.exUz: Menejer iste'foga chiqqanidan so'ng u loyihani boshqarishni o'z qo'liga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqaruvni o'z qo'liga olmoq.
